name: Skeuomorphic icon
region: Apple Mac OS X Aqua, then iOS and the Tango Desktop Project
summary: Icons that look like small real objects: leather, glass, metal and paper, with light from the top, gradients and a soft cast shadow. The style peaked with Mac OS X Aqua and iOS 1 to 6, and Tango gave it an open, semi-realistic form.

philosophy.core_thesis: An icon is a small picture of a real object, and the material tells the user what the function is.
design_principles: Draw the master at 256 or 512 px and make hand-tuned copies at 16, 22, 32 and 48 px.
Light every object from the top or the top left, at 45°, with one highlight and one shade side.
Give each surface a material: a linear gradient of 2 to 5 stops for metal, glass, wood or paper.
Add a 1 px light inner edge on the top and a 1 px dark outline at 20–40% opacity around the object.
Cast a soft shadow under the object at 20–35% opacity, offset 1–3 px down at 32 px.
Use a three-quarter or slight top-down view so that the object shows depth.
anti_patterns: Flat fills with no light model
Uniform stroke width across the set
Abstract symbols with no real object

grid.keylines: A circle of 44 px, a square of 40 px and a three-quarter box; the object may break the keyline by 2 px.

stroke.rule: The outline is a 1 px edge in a darker tone of the fill at 20–40% opacity, not a drawn stroke.

shape.primitives: Real object outlines: rounded boxes, cylinders, sheets of paper and glass panes.
shape.optical_size: Redraw the 16 and 22 px sizes with fewer parts and a stronger outline; keep texture only at 48 px and above.

colour.strategy: A full colour palette from the Tango set, with each hue in 3 tones (light, mid, dark) and linear or radial gradients.

perspective_and_light.light: One key light from the top left at 45°, with a specular highlight on glass and metal.
perspective_and_light.shadow: A soft cast shadow at 20–35% opacity under the object, and a contact shadow at the base.

metaphor.typical: A letter, a globe, a printer, a camera, a notepad and a house.
metaphor.treatment: Literal real objects with their material: a mail icon is an envelope with paper texture.

emotion.target_response: Comfort and trust: the user sees a familiar object and knows what it does.

use_cases: brand illustrations with a tactile feel
avoid_when: The icons must sit inline with text at 16–24 px.
The set needs hundreds of glyphs that stay the same.

modifiers.how: Keep the object and the colours; drop the gradients, the highlight and the shadow, and use a front view.
Keep the depth; replace hard gloss with a matte, clay-like material and a larger corner radius of 12–16 px at 48 px.

grid_size.note: Below 32 px the texture and the light do not read.
